description: I'm David Bennett, and I believe every household should have a plan for when the lights go out, the heating stops and the supermarket shelves run thin. This channel is where I help you prepare for those moments here in the UK. From what to stock up on and which emergency kit is worth your money, to long-life food, winter essentials and keeping your home and family safe. Whether you're just getting started, living on your own or looking after a whole family, you'll find straightforward advice and practical steps you can take before trouble arrives.
